question: Will any North American country have a CDC travel advisory issued in November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: CDC's THN page currently lists North American notices first issued Jun 4 (Hep A Canada), Jun 25 (Diphtheria Haiti), Jul 16 (Chikungunya Costa Rica), ~summer (Chikungunya Nicaragua), Sep 18 (Hep A Costa Rica), plus Cuba chikungunya Sep 2025 and Mexico RMSF Dec 2025, roughly 0.35-0.5 new NA notices per month, so P(at least one in Nov) is about 30-45%. Adjusted down slightly: none was issued in October, November is the start of the Central American dry season when arboviral outbreaks fall off, and the large Guatemala/Mexico measles epidemics are covered by the existing Global Measles notice rather than country-specific ones. Upside risks: the measles burden, chikungunya activity, and fragile settings (Haiti, Cuba). Updates to existing notices likely do not count as 'newly issued'. No human market found (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi: none).
calls.dossier:
- Resolution instrument: resolves off the CDC THN page (wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices), on a notice for a North American country NEWLY issued in Nov 2026. A date bump on an existing notice tagged 'Updated' is probably not 'newly issued'. The question background counts the 'most recent new notice' as Hep A Costa Rica on Sep 18, 2026.
- Event window: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-30 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-31 0% elapsed.
- Status quo: no new North American notice since Sep 18, 2026; none in October 2026 (CDC THN page fetched 2026-10-31).
- Current North American notices on the CDC page (fetched 2026-10-31): Chikungunya Nicaragua L2 (updated Sep 3, 2026); Chikungunya Costa Rica L2 (updated Jul 30, first issued Jul 16, 2026); Hep A Costa Rica L1 (new Sep 18, 2026); Diphtheria Haiti L1 (new Jun 25, 2026); Hep A Canada L1 (new Jun 4, 2026); RMSF Mexico L1 (Dec 22-23, 2025).
- Earlier: Chikungunya Cuba L2 issued Sep 26, 2025 (web search summary); Oropouche Cuba notices 2024-25 (110 US traveler cases from Cuba 2024-25; none in the US in 2026 as of Oct 6).
- Rough rate: about 5-7 new North American notices over Sep 2025-Oct 2026 (~14 months), bunched in Jun-Sep 2026, so about 0.35-0.5 per month; within 2026 alone about 5 in 10 months. Initial issue date for Nicaragua chikungunya not found.
- Worldwide new-notice pace (CDC page): Oct 2026 new notices were Yellow Fever Ghana (Oct 16) and Ebola Kenya (Oct 19); both non-North American.
- Measles: PAHO/Contagion Live (Oct 30, 2026) report 55,792 cases in the Americas, mostly Guatemala (34,355) and Mexico (13,595), plus Canada 1,121; CDC handles measles through the 'Global Measles' notice (May 28, 2025), not country-specific ones.
- Chikungunya: PAHO Oct 20, 2026 counts 213,919 suspected cases in the Americas (weeks 1-38) and warns of the approaching South American peak season; Central America enters the dry season in Nov.
- Costa Rica declared a new chikungunya outbreak in Pavas, San Jose on Sep 17, 2026 (already covered by the existing CR notice).
- Searched but not found: any pending Nov 2026 CDC North American notice; Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold markets (none); first-issue date of the Nicaragua notice.
calls.reference_class: Calendar months Sep 2025-Oct 2026 checked for at least one new (not updated) CDC Travel Health Notice for a North American country, Caribbean included

calls.reasoning: Base rate: in the last ~24 months, about 7-9 calendar months had a new North American (incl. Central America/Caribbean) CDC THN; this is a floor because the feed only lists active notices (retired ones such as Cuba chikungunya and Oropouche are missing), giving ~30-35%/month. The 2026 pace was higher (Canada and Haiti in Jun, Costa Rica chikungunya in Jul, Nicaragua chikungunya, Costa Rica HepA on Sep 18), but nothing new in October. Arguments for Yes: large uncovered chikungunya outbreaks in Guatemala (~34k suspected cases) and Mexico (~13.6k) per PAHO's Oct 20 update. Arguments for No: CDC has not acted on Guatemala yet, many North American notices are updated rather than newly issued, and only new notices count. Market check: none found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, or bookmakers.

calls.reasoning: Base rate: roughly 5-6 of the last 14 calendar months had a newly issued CDC THN for a North American country (Sep 2025 Cuba chik, Dec 2025 Mexico RMSF, Jun 2026 Canada HepA + Haiti diphtheria, Jul 2026 Costa Rica chik, Sep 2026 Costa Rica HepA, plus likely Nicaragua chik), i.e. ~35-43%/month, slightly higher if retired notices are missing from the feed. Adjustments down: no NA notice in October, November is the start of the Central American dry season, measles goes under the Global notice, and updates likely don't count. Adjustments up: large chikungunya outbreaks in Guatemala and Mexico with no CDC notice yet, plus fragile settings (Haiti, Cuba). No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: No web access on this run. All three dossiers agree on the factual state: no NA notice newly issued in October 2026; the active NA notices and their dates match across runs. The one factual dispute, the count of new NA notices over the past 12-24 months (3-9 depending on window and the unknown first-issue dates for the Nicaragua/Costa Rica chik notices), can't be settled from the dossiers. My month-level count is ~5-6 of 14 months, ~35-43%. Whether updates count: all runs infer they don't, from the question background ignoring the Oct 2 Global Dengue update; I accept that. The remaining disputes are judgment (seasonality, the uncovered Guatemala/Mexico outbreaks); I land slightly below the historical rate because October was empty and the dry season is starting.
